title: A Request for a Meeting
text:
Dear Mr. Brown, I am writing to ask for a meeting about our new project. Could we meet next Tuesday at 10 a.m.? I would be happy to come to your office.

Please let me know if this time is good for you. If Tuesday does not work, I can also meet on Thursday afternoon. Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

questions.text: When does the writer want to meet Mr. Brown?
According to paragraph two, what can the writer do if Tuesday does not work?
What is the writer's relationship to Mr. Brown most likely?
Why does the writer say 'I look forward to hearing from you'?
options: To politely ask for a reply
To complain about a late meeting

vocabulary.definition: a planned piece of work that has a clear goal
an event where people come together to discuss something
a room or building where people do their work
the part of the day between noon and evening

paragraph_translations: Sayın Bay Brown, yeni projemiz hakkında bir toplantı yapmak için yazıyorum. Gelecek salı günü saat 10.00'da görüşebilir miyiz? Ofisinize gelmekten memnuniyet duyarım.
Bu zamanın sizin için uygun olup olmadığını lütfen bana bildirin. Salı günü olmazsa, perşembe öğleden sonra da görüşebilirim. Zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederim. Yanıtınızı bekliyorum.
